name: Biodiesel
description:
Biodiesel is a Liquid composed of highly processed fatty acids derived from purified natural oils.

Its combustibility makes it useful for Power production.

name: Brackene
description:
Brackene is a sodium-rich Liquid.

It is useful in Ranching.

name: Brine
description:
Brine is a natural, highly concentrated solution of Salt dissolved in Water.

It can be used in desalination processes, separating out usable salt.

name: Crude Oil
description:
Crude Oil is a raw potential Power source composed of billions of dead, primordial organisms.

It is also a useful lubricant for certain types of machinery.

name: Ethanol
description:
(C2H6O) Ethanol is an advanced chemical compound in a Liquid state.

It can be used as a highly effective fuel source when burned.

name: Gunk
description:
Gunk is the built-up grime and grit produced by Duplicants' bionic mechanisms.

It is unpleasantly viscous.

name: Latex
description:
Latex is a naturally derived colloidal dispersion of polymer particles in Liquid.

It can be used to produce Rubber.

name: Liquid Carbon
description: (C) Liquid Carbon is an abundant, versatile element heated into a Liquid state.

name: Liquid Carbon Dioxide
description:
(CO2) Carbon Dioxide is an unbreathable chemical compound.

This selection is currently in a Liquid state.

name: Liquid Chlorine
description: (Cl) Chlorine is a natural Germ-killing element in a Liquid state.

name: Liquid Hydrogen
description:
(H) Hydrogen in its Liquid state.

It freezes most substances that come into contact with it.

name: Liquid Methane
description:
(CH4) Methane is an alkane.

This selection is in a Liquid state.

name: Liquid Naphtha
description: Naphtha a distilled hydrocarbon mixture produced from the burning of Plastic.

name: Liquid Nuclear Waste
description: Highly toxic liquid full of Radioactive Contaminants which emit Radiation that can be absorbed by Radbolt Generators.

name: Liquid Oxygen
description:
(O2) Oxygen is a breathable chemical.

This selection is in a Liquid state.

name: Liquid Phosphorus
description:
(P) Phosphorus is a chemical element.

This selection is in a Liquid state.

name: Liquid Propane
description:
(C3H8) Propane is an alkane.

This selection is in a Liquid state.

It is useful in Power production.

name: Liquid Sucrose
description: (C12H22O11) Liquid Sucrose is the raw form of sugar, heated into a Liquid state.

name: Liquid Sulfur
description:
(S) Sulfur is a common chemical element and byproduct of Natural Gas production.

This selection is in a Liquid state.

name: Liquid Uranium
description:
(U) Liquid Uranium is a highly Radioactive substance, heated into a hazardous Liquid state.

It is a byproduct of Enriched Uranium.

name: Magma
description: Magma is a composite of Igneous Rock heated into a molten, Liquid state.

name: Mercury
description: (Hg) Mercury is a metallic Liquid.

name: Molten Aluminum
description: (Al) Molten Aluminum is a low density Metal heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Cobalt
description: (Co) Molten Cobalt is a Refined Metal heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Copper
description: (Cu) Molten Copper is a conductive Metal heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Glass
description: Molten Glass is a composite of granular rock, heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Gold
description: (Au) Gold, a conductive precious Metal, heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Iridium
description: (Ir) Molten Iridium is a highly conductive Metal heated to a Liquid state.

name: Molten Iron
description: (Fe) Molten Iron is a common industrial Metal heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Lead
description: (Pb) Lead is an extremely dense Refined Metal heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Nickel
description: (Ni) Molten Nickel is a conductive Metal heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Niobium
description: (Nb) Molten Niobium is a rare metal heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Salt
description: (NaCl) Molten Salt is an edible chemical compound that has been heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Steel
description: Molten Steel is a Metal alloy of iron and carbon, heated into a hazardous Liquid state.

name: Molten Tungsten
description: (W) Molten Tungsten is a crystalline Metal heated into a Liquid state.

name: Molten Zinc
description: Molten Zinc is Zinc heated into Liquid state.

name: Mucin
description:
Mucin is an extremely viscous Liquid gel composed of natural enzymes and polysaccharides.

Its unusually thick consistency can result in formations atypical of most liquids.

name: Nectar
description: Nectar is a natural, lightly concentrated solution of Sucrose dissolved in Water.

name: Ovolene
description:
Ovolene is a protein-rich Liquid produced by aquatic critters.

It can be processed into Caviar and Mucin.

name: Petroleum
description:
Petroleum is a Power source refined from Crude Oil.

It is also an essential ingredient in the production of Plastic.

name: Phyto Oil
description: Phyto Oil is a thick, slippery Liquid extracted from pureed Slime.

name: Polluted Brine
description:
Polluted Brine is a murky, concentrated solution of Salt dissolved in Polluted Water.

It can be used in desalination processes, separating out usable salt.

name: Polluted Water
description:
Polluted Water is dirty, unfiltered Water.

It is not fit for consumption.

name: Resin
description:
Resin is a viscous organic Liquid.

It can be treated to become Plastic in the Polymer Press.

name: Salt Water
description:
Salt Water is a natural, lightly concentrated solution of Salt dissolved in Water.

It can be used in desalination processes, separating out usable salt.

name: Sap
description:
Sticky goo harvested from a grumpy tree.

It can be polymerized into Isosap by boiling away its excess moisture.

name: Squid Ink
description:
Squid Ink is a heavily pigmented organic Liquid composed of Mucin, melanin, and Refined Carbon.

It possesses useful Radiation absorption properties.

name: Super Coolant
description:
Super Coolant is an industrial-grade coolant that utilizes the unusual energy states of Fullerene.

This selection is in a Liquid state.

name: Visco-Gel Fluid
description: Visco-Gel Fluid is a Liquid polymer with high surface tension, preventing typical liquid flow and allowing for unusual configurations.

name: Water
description: (H2O) Clean Water, suitable for consumption.
